annotations.title: The person's work history, read from their saved CV

description: The person's work history, read from their saved CV. For filling in application forms, LinkedIn or a profile, or "how many years have I been a nurse?". Each role with its title, employer, place, start and end month, months in the role and its bullet points (most recent first, as on the CV), plus education lines and total years of work. It is a best guess from the CV text, so check it with the person before it goes into a form. A ready-to-read summary is in `say`.
name: get_work_history
